§6Demon Core§f

§aTwo beryllium half-spheres with a plutonium pit. A screwdriver keeps it from going critical.§f

The §bDemon Core§f references the infamous real-life criticality accident. In NTM, it comes in two states:
§b• Suspended (Open)§f, held together by a screwdriver, emits §e5 RAD/s§f. Not used in recipes.
§b• Closed§f, drop the suspended version to close it, emits §e100,000 RAD/s§f. This is what you craft with.

§6Uses§f:
§b• Fau Armor§f, closed demon core in the chestplate recipe
§b• DNT Nano Suit Boots§f, closed core flanked by DNT armor plating
§b• Crucible (Weapon)§f, yharonite + closed core + yharonite
§b• Demon Core Lamp§f, emits blue radiation light, §e100k-750k RAD/s§f depending on distance

§cWARNING:§f The closed demon core is absurdly radioactive. Handle with full hazmat and keep it stored when not in use. The lamp variant is decorative but will irradiate anything nearby.

§ePS:§f You'll need at least two demon cores for endgame armor (one for Fau, one for DNT Nano Suit). They don't stack, so plan your storage carefully.
